svg.title: Office 1st floor plan

g.text: Scale: 50 × 13 m · doors drawn with swing · thick line = high back (booth)
Blue door at both ends = glass emergency exit (end walls also have curved glass above 3.1 m)
Dashed orange = mezzanine at 3.0 m (2 rooms + 1 m walkway) · gray = metal stairs (arrow = up)
Blue = clear glass (HR: 1 m wall + glass) · pale = milk glass, opaque with clear top 50 cm
Red = framed prints on the corridor walls · green dots = standing plants · gray = Orbid floor mats
Blue carpet, flat 2.6 m ceiling, toilets copied with light gray tiles. Stair shaft with one big window; west double door closed.
Doors: gray on the 4e, white on the 3e; stairway doors blue, toilet + utility doors green; Graslei/Korenlei glass (E opens in 3D).

svg.text: Seat numbers: blue = desk seat · orange = meeting / kitchen / lounge seat · amber = mezzanine (Graslei, Korenlei) · full list in seats.md
